presentation.title: Three-tier web application — Dimentionalizer
presentation.headline: Three-tier web application.
presentation.description: A familiar web stack: browser, reverse proxy, application, relational data, cache, and background e-mail. An editable reference pattern.

objects.name: Web browser
objects.description: Renders pages and makes authenticated HTTPS requests. Represents a client, not a deployed server.

objects.name: Static asset CDN
objects.description: Caches versioned JavaScript, stylesheets, and public images at the edge.

objects.name: Reverse proxy
objects.description: Terminates public traffic and forwards dynamic requests to the application.

objects.name: Web application
objects.description: Handles page rendering, business rules, and database transactions in one deployable application.

objects.name: Application database
objects.description: Stores users, application records, and transactional state.

objects.name: Session & response cache
objects.description: Stores short-lived sessions and selected response data. The database remains authoritative.

objects.name: File storage
objects.description: Stores public assets and user uploads; private files require authorization before delivery.

objects.name: Job queue
objects.description: Buffers slow work so interactive requests do not wait for delivery.

objects.name: Background worker
objects.description: Consumes queued work and sends transactional notifications.

objects.name: E-mail provider
objects.description: Delivers account and application notifications through an external provider.
